original_query: with customer_total_return as (select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk ,sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(SR_REFUNDED_CASH) as ctr_total_return from store_returns ,date_dim where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year =2001 and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 236 and 295 group by sr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk)  select  c_customer_id from customer_total_return ctr1 ,store ,customer ,customer_demographics where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2 from customer_total_return ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk ) and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31 and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI') and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'W') and cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College') and cd_gender = 'M' and c_birth_month = 5 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956 order by c_customer_id limit 100;

tpch.rewritten_query:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
        sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
        SUM(SR_REFUNDED_CASH) AS ctr_total_return 
    FROM 
        store_returns
        JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 2001 
        AND sr_return_amt BETWEEN 236 * sr_return_quantity AND 295 * sr_return_quantity
    GROUP BY 
        sr_customer_sk, 
        sr_store_sk, 
        sr_reason_sk
)
SELECT 
    c_customer_id
FROM 
    customer_total_return ctr1
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            ctr_store_sk, 
            AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_ctr
        FROM 
            customer_total_return 
        GROUP BY 
            ctr_store_sk
    ) ctr_avg ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr_avg.ctr_store_sk
    JOIN store ON 
        s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk 
        AND s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI')
    JOIN customer ON 
        ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
        AND c_birth_month = 5
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956
    JOIN customer_demographics ON 
        c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
        AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
        AND cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College')
        AND cd_gender = 'M'
WHERE 
    ctr1.ctr_total_return > ctr_avg.avg_ctr
    AND ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31
ORDER BY 
    c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) cnt3, cd_dep_count, COUNT(*) cnt4, cd_dep_employed_count, COUNT(*) cnt5, cd_dep_college_count, COUNT(*) cnt6
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  AND ca.ca_county IN ('Benton County','Clarke County','La Paz County','Lexington city','Power County')
  AND c.c_birth_month IN (9, 11)
JOIN customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
  AND cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'W', 'M')
  AND cd_education_status IN ('Unknown','College')
  AND cd_gender = 'F'
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1998
    AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 10
    AND i_category IN ('Children','Electronics','Home')
    AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.0
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 68 AND 77
) store_sub ON c.c_customer_sk = store_sub.ss_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1998
    AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 10
    AND i_category IN ('Children','Electronics','Home')
    AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.0
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 68 AND 77
) web_sub ON c.c_customer_sk = web_sub.ws_bill_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1998
    AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 10
    AND i_category IN ('Children','Electronics','Home')
    AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.0
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 68 AND 77
) catalog_sub ON c.c_customer_sk = catalog_sub.cs_ship_customer_sk
WHERE store_sub.ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND (web_sub.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL OR catalog_sub.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM 
        store_sales
        JOIN date_dim d ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        JOIN item i ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 2002
        AND d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
        AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
        AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.0
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
    UNION
    SELECT 
        ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM 
        web_sales
        JOIN date_dim d ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        JOIN item i ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 2002
        AND d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
        AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
        AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.0
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
    UNION
    SELECT 
        cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM 
        catalog_sales
        JOIN date_dim d ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        JOIN item i ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 2002
        AND d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
        AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
        AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.0
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
)
SELECT 
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) cnt1,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) cnt2,
    cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) cnt3,
    cd_dep_count,
    COUNT(*) cnt4,
    cd_dep_employed_count,
    COUNT(*) cnt5,
    cd_dep_college_count,
    COUNT(*) cnt6
FROM 
    customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
    LEFT JOIN sales_data s ON c.c_customer_sk = s.customer_sk
WHERE 
    ca_county IN ('Baldwin County','Cocke County','Elko County','Geauga County','Marengo County')
    AND c.c_birth_month IN (6, 7)
    AND cd_marital_status IN ('U', 'S')
    AND cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary')
    AND cd_gender = 'F'
    AND s.customer_sk IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd_credit_rating,
    cd_dep_count,
    cd_dep_employed_count,
    cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY 
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd_credit_rating,
    cd_dep_count,
    cd_dep_employed_count,
    cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    avg(ss_quantity), 
    avg(ss_ext_sales_price), 
    avg(ss_ext_wholesale_cost), 
    sum(ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM (
    -- Branch 1: cd_marital_status='U'
    SELECT ss_quantity, ss_ext_sales_price, ss_ext_wholesale_cost
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
    JOIN customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'College'
    JOIN household_demographics ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND hd_dep_count = 3
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('IN', 'NM', 'VA')
    WHERE ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
      AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Branch 2: cd_marital_status='W'
    SELECT ss_quantity, ss_ext_sales_price, ss_ext_wholesale_cost
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
    JOIN customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree'
    JOIN household_demographics ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND hd_dep_count = 1
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('MT', 'OH', 'OR')
    WHERE ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
      AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Branch 3: cd_marital_status='S'
    SELECT ss_quantity, ss_ext_sales_price, ss_ext_wholesale_cost
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
    JOIN customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College'
    JOIN household_demographics ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND hd_dep_count = 1
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'TX')
    WHERE ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
      AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
) AS combined_data;

SELECT avg(ss_quantity), avg(ss_ext_sales_price), avg(ss_ext_wholesale_cost), sum(ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM store_sales
JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status FROM customer_demographics 
      WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('U','S') AND cd_education_status IN ('College','Secondary')) AS cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk
JOIN (SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_dep_count FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_dep_count IN (1,3)) AS hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk
JOIN (SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state FROM customer_address 
      WHERE ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('AR','OK','TX','KS','MN','MD','NV')) AS ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = store_sales.ss_addr_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d ON d.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
WHERE (
    (ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 3 AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College')
    OR (ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1 AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College')
    OR (ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1 AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary')
) AND (
    (ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200 AND ca.ca_state IN ('AR','OK','TX'))
    OR (ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300 AND ca.ca_state IN ('KS','MN','TX'))
    OR (ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250 AND ca.ca_state IN ('KS','MD','NV'))
);

WITH cross_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk
  FROM item,
    (SELECT iss.i_brand_id AS brand_id, iss.i_class_id AS class_id, iss.i_category_id AS category_id
     FROM store_sales, item iss, date_dim d1
     WHERE ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
       AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
       AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
       AND iss.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
       AND iss.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
       AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
     INTERSECT
     SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
     FROM catalog_sales, item ics, date_dim d2
     WHERE cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
       AND cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
       AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
       AND ics.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
       AND ics.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
       AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
     INTERSECT
     SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
     FROM web_sales, item iws, date_dim d3
     WHERE ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
       AND ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
       AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
       AND iws.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
       AND iws.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
       AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    ) AS x
  WHERE i_brand_id = brand_id
    AND i_class_id = class_id
    AND i_category_id = category_id
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales, date_dim
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
    FROM catalog_sales, date_dim
    WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price
    FROM web_sales, date_dim
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
      AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
  ) AS x
)
SELECT
  this_year.channel AS ty_channel,
  this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
  this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
  this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
  this_year.sales AS ty_sales,
  this_year.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
  last_year.channel AS ly_channel,
  last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
  last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
  last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
  last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
  last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM (
  SELECT
    'store' AS channel,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales, item, date_dim
  WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items)
    AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    AND d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq
                      FROM date_dim
                      WHERE d_year = 1999
                        AND d_moy = 12
                        AND d_dom = 5)
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
) AS this_year,
(
  SELECT
    'store' AS channel,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales, item, date_dim
  WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items)
    AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    AND d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq
                      FROM date_dim
                      WHERE d_year = 1998
                        AND d_moy = 12
                        AND d_dom = 5)
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
) AS last_year
WHERE this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id
  AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id
  AND this_year.i_category_id = last_year.i_category_id
ORDER BY this_year.channel, this_year.i_brand_id, this_year.i_class_id, this_year.i_category_id
LIMIT 100;

FROM
    (SELECT * FROM store_sales WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) AS store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND d_moy = 8

    JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_month = 4

GROUP BY
    i_brand,
    i_brand_id,
    i_manufact_id,
    i_manufact
ORDER BY
    ext_price DESC,
    i_brand,
    i_brand_id,
    i_manufact_id,

    MIN(item.i_brand_id),
    MIN(item.i_manufact_id),
    MIN(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price)

    (SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_ext_sales_price
     FROM store_sales
     WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43) AS store_sales
INNER JOIN
    (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 3) AS date_dim
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN
    (SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Sports') AS item
    ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN
    (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM customer WHERE c_birth_month = 10) AS customer
    ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN
    (SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_zip FROM customer_address WHERE ca_state = 'VA') AS customer_address
    ON customer.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN
    (SELECT s_store_sk, s_zip FROM store) AS store
    ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
WHERE
    SUBSTRING(customer_address.ca_zip, 1, 5) <> SUBSTRING(store.s_zip, 1, 5);

WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca_state AS ctr_state,
        wr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM 
        web_returns
        JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
        JOIN customer_address ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
        JOIN item ON wr_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 2001
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 69 AND 78
        AND wr_return_amt BETWEEN 28 * wr_return_quantity AND 57 * wr_return_quantity
        AND ca_state IN ('IA', 'MT', 'NE', 'TX')
        AND wr_reason_sk IN (3, 31)
    GROUP BY 
        wr_returning_customer_sk, 
        ca_state, 
        wr_reason_sk
),
state_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ctr_state, 
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_val
    FROM 
        customer_total_return
    GROUP BY 
        ctr_state
)
SELECT 
    c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address,
    c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return
FROM 
    customer_total_return ctr1
    JOIN state_avg sa ON ctr1.ctr_state = sa.ctr_state AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.avg_val
    JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
WHERE
    c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
ORDER BY 
    c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address,
    c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk 
    FROM item 
    WHERE i_color IN ('purple', 'sandy')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 55
),
ss AS (
    SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 91
      AND ca_state IN ('GA','IL')
      AND d_year = 2001
      AND d_qoy IN (1,2,3)
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
),
ws AS (
    SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    JOIN filtered_item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 91
      AND ca_state IN ('GA','IL')
      AND d_year = 2001
      AND d_qoy IN (1,2,3)
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
)
SELECT 
    ss1.ca_county,
    ss1.d_year,
    ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales AS web_q1_q2_increase,
    ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales AS store_q1_q2_increase,
    ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales AS web_q2_q3_increase,
    ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales AS store_q2_q3_increase
FROM ss ss1
JOIN ss ss2 
  ON ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county 
  AND ss1.d_qoy = 1 
  AND ss1.d_year = 2001
  AND ss2.d_qoy = 2 
  AND ss2.d_year = 2001
JOIN ss ss3 
  ON ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county 
  AND ss3.d_qoy = 3 
  AND ss3.d_year = 2001

  AND ws1.d_qoy = 1 
  AND ws1.d_year = 2001
JOIN ws ws2

  AND ws2.d_qoy = 2 
  AND ws2.d_year = 2001
JOIN ws ws3 
  ON ws1.ca_county = ws3.ca_county 
  AND ws3.d_qoy = 3 
  AND ws3.d_year = 2001
WHERE CASE WHEN ws1.web_sales > 0 THEN ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales ELSE NULL END
        > CASE WHEN ss1.store_sales > 0 THEN ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales ELSE NULL END
  AND CASE WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0 THEN ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales ELSE NULL END

WITH inv AS (
  SELECT 
    w_warehouse_name, 
    w_warehouse_sk, 
    i_item_sk, 
    d_moy, 
    stdev, 
    mean, 
    CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END AS cov
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      w_warehouse_name, 
      w_warehouse_sk, 
      i_item_sk, 
      d_moy, 
      STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev, 
      AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean
    FROM 
      inventory, 
      item, 
      warehouse, 
      date_dim
    WHERE 
      inv_item_sk = i_item_sk
      AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
      AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year = 1998
      AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47
      AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425
      AND d_moy IN (2, 3)  -- FILTER_INTO_JOIN: 谓词下推
    GROUP BY 
      w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy
    HAVING 
      CASE WHEN AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN 0 
           ELSE STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) / AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) 
      END > 1  -- FILTER_AGGREGATE_TRANSPOSE: 聚合过滤下推
  ) AS foo
)
SELECT 
  inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov,
  inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov
FROM 
  inv inv1, 
  inv inv2
WHERE 
  inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk
  AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk
  AND inv1.d_moy = 2
  AND inv2.d_moy = 3  -- 2+1 计算结果
ORDER BY 
  inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov,
  inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov;

       inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov

    inventory inv

    JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE 
    d.d_year = 2001

    CASE 
      WHEN AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN NULL 
      ELSE STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) / AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) 
    END AS cov
  FROM 
    filtered_data
  GROUP BY 
    w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy
  HAVING 
    CASE 
      WHEN AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN 0 
      ELSE STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) / AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) 
    END > 1
)

  JOIN agg_data inv2

WHERE

tpch.rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_data AS (
    SELECT 
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        i.i_item_sk,
        d.d_moy,
        STDDEV_SAMP(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev,
        AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean
    FROM 
        inventory AS inv
        JOIN item AS i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Men')
            AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100
        JOIN warehouse AS w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN date_dim AS d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            AND d.d_year = 2000
    WHERE 
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 376 AND 576
    GROUP BY 
        w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, i.i_item_sk, d.d_moy
),
inv AS (
    SELECT 
        w_warehouse_name,
        w_warehouse_sk,
        i_item_sk,
        d_moy,
        stdev,
        mean,
        CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END AS cov
    FROM 
        filtered_data
    WHERE 
        CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev/mean END > 1
)
SELECT 
    inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov,
    inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov
FROM 
    inv AS inv1
    JOIN inv AS inv2 
        ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk
        AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk
        AND inv1.d_moy = 1
        AND inv2.d_moy = 1 + 1
WHERE 
    inv1.cov > 1.5
ORDER BY 
    inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov,
    inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov;

    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM
    store_sales
    JOIN store_returns ON store_sales.ss_ticket_number = store_returns.sr_ticket_number
        AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk
        AND store_sales.ss_customer_sk = store_returns.sr_customer_sk
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk

    JOIN d2_filtered ON store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = d2_filtered.d_date_sk
WHERE
    d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2_filtered.d_date - INTERVAL '120' DAY) AND d2_filtered.d_date
GROUP BY
    store.s_store_name,
    store.s_company_id,
    store.s_street_number,
    store.s_street_name,
    store.s_street_type,
    store.s_suite_number,
    store.s_city,
    store.s_county,
    store.s_state,
    store.s_zip
ORDER BY
    store.s_store_name,
    store.s_company_id,
    store.s_street_number,
    store.s_street_name,
    store.s_street_type,
    store.s_suite_number,
    store.s_city,
    store.s_county,
    store.s_state,
    store.s_zip
LIMIT 100;

WITH month_seq_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 1 AS start_seq,
                    d_month_seq + 3 AS end_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy = 6
),
my_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk,
                    c_current_addr_sk
    FROM (
        SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
               cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
               cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
               cs_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost
        FROM catalog_sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
               ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
               ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
               ws_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost
        FROM web_sales
    ) cs_or_ws_sales
    JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Electronics' AND i_class = 'portable') item ON cs_or_ws_sales.item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 6 AND d_year = 2002) date_dim ON cs_or_ws_sales.sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM customer WHERE c_birth_year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1991) customer ON cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    WHERE wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100
),
my_revenue AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM my_customers
    JOIN (SELECT ss_customer_sk, ss_ext_sales_price, ss_sold_date_sk FROM store_sales WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100) store_sales ON my_customers.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON my_customers.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
    JOIN (SELECT s_county, s_state FROM store WHERE s_state IN ('AL','AR','FL','MN','MO','NC','NY','OK','PA','WI')) store ON customer_address.ca_county = store.s_county AND customer_address.ca_state = store.s_state
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim
          WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT start_seq FROM month_seq_base) AND (SELECT end_seq FROM month_seq_base)
    ) date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY c_customer_sk
),
segments AS (
    SELECT CAST((revenue/50) AS INT) AS segment
    FROM my_revenue
)
SELECT segment,
       COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
       segment*50 AS segment_base
FROM segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment, num_customers
LIMIT 100;

WITH date_filter AS (
    SELECT d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2001-04-16')
),
ss_items AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id AS item_id,
        c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
    FROM 
        store_sales
        JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    WHERE 
        d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_filter)
        AND ss_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
    GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id AS item_id,
        c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
    FROM 
        catalog_sales
        JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        JOIN customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    WHERE 
        d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_filter)
        AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
    GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
ws_items AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id AS item_id,
        c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
    FROM 
        web_sales
        JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        JOIN customer ON ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    WHERE 
        d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_filter)
        AND ws_list_price BETWEEN 94 AND 123
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
    GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
)
SELECT 
    ss_items.item_id,
    ss_items.birth_year,
    ss_item_rev,
    ss_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev,
    cs_item_rev,
    cs_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev,
    ws_item_rev,
    ws_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev,
    (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average
FROM 
    ss_items

    AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
ORDER BY 
    item_id, 
    birth_year,
    ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100;

tpch.rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price > 50
      AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
),
filtered_promotion AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
      AND p_channel_tv = 'N'
      AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
      AND p_channel_press = 'N'
      AND p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-08-11' AS DATE) AND CAST('2001-08-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
ssr AS (
    SELECT s_store_id AS store_id,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
           SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_date ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
    WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
    GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
           SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
           SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_date ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_promotion ON cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT web_site_id,
           SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
           SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_date ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_promotion ON ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number
    WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
    GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || store_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           profit
    FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

WITH ssr AS (
  SELECT 
    s_store_id AS store_id,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM (
    SELECT * 
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE 
      ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48
      AND ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND ss_store_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND ss_promo_sk IS NOT NULL
  ) AS store_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON 
    store_sales.ss_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk 
    AND store_sales.ss_ticket_number = store_returns.sr_ticket_number
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON 
    store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
    AND date_dim.d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
  INNER JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
  INNER JOIN item ON 
    store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
    AND item.i_current_price > 50 
    AND item.i_category IN ('Home', 'Men')
  INNER JOIN promotion ON 
    store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk 
    AND promotion.p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N'
    AND promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND promotion.p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y'
  GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT 
    cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
    SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM (
    SELECT * 
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE 
      cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48
      AND cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND cs_catalog_page_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND cs_promo_sk IS NOT NULL
  ) AS catalog_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON 
    catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = catalog_returns.cr_item_sk 
    AND catalog_sales.cs_order_number = catalog_returns.cr_order_number
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON 
    catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
    AND date_dim.d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
  INNER JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_sales.cs_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN item ON 
    catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
    AND item.i_current_price > 50 
    AND item.i_category IN ('Home', 'Men')
  INNER JOIN promotion ON 
    catalog_sales.cs_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk 
    AND promotion.p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N'
    AND promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND promotion.p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y'
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT 
    web_site_id,
    SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM (
    SELECT * 
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE 
      ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48
      AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND ws_web_site_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND ws_promo_sk IS NOT NULL
  ) AS web_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON 
    web_sales.ws_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk 
    AND web_sales.ws_order_number = web_returns.wr_order_number
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON 
    web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
    AND date_dim.d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
  INNER JOIN web_site ON web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
  INNER JOIN item ON 
    web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
    AND item.i_current_price > 50 
    AND item.i_category IN ('Home', 'Men')
  INNER JOIN promotion ON 
    web_sales.ws_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk 
    AND promotion.p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N'
    AND promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND promotion.p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y'
  GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT 
  channel,
  id,
  SUM(sales) AS sales,
  SUM(returns) AS returns,
  SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM catalog_returns
  JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  WHERE 
    d_year = 1998
    AND ca_state = 'IL'  -- 谓词简化：提前应用州过滤
  GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),
state_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_state,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_val
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT 
  c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name,
  ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number,
  ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset,
  ca_location_type, ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN state_avg ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
WHERE 
  ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_val  -- 子查询优化：转换为JOIN比较
ORDER BY 
  c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name,
  ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number,
  ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset,
  ca_location_type, ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

),

  JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE 
    d_month_seq IN (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_cte)
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45
    AND cr_return_amount BETWEEN 141 * cr_return_quantity AND 170 * cr_return_quantity
    AND cr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
  GROUP BY i_item_id
),

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT substring(r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee)
FROM web_sales
JOIN web_returns ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number
JOIN web_page ON ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk
JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2000) d ON ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr_returning_cdemo_sk
JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN reason ON r_reason_sk = wr_reason_sk
WHERE 
    ws_web_page_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND wp_web_page_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND wr_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ws_order_number IS NOT NULL
    AND wr_order_number IS NOT NULL
    AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND d.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND cd1.cd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND wr_refunded_cdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND cd2.cd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND wr_returning_cdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND wr_refunded_addr_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND r_reason_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND wr_reason_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        (
            cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D'
            AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
            AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
        )
        OR (
            cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S'
            AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
            AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
        )
        OR (
            cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U'
            AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree'
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
            AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
        )
    )
    AND (
        (
            ca_country = 'United States'
            AND ca_state IN ('AR', 'FL', 'WI')
            AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
        )
        OR (
            ca_country = 'United States'
            AND ca_state IN ('MO', 'NC', 'PA')
            AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
        )
        OR (
            ca_country = 'United States'
            AND ca_state IN ('AR', 'OK', 'TX')
            AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
        )
    )
GROUP BY r_reason_desc
ORDER BY substring(r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100;

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT MIN(ws_quantity),
       MIN(wr_refunded_cash),
       MIN(wr_fee),
       MIN(ws_item_sk),
       MIN(wr_order_number),
       MIN(cd1.cd_demo_sk),
       MIN(cd2.cd_demo_sk)
FROM web_sales
JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998
JOIN web_returns ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number
JOIN web_page ON ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr_returning_cdemo_sk
JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN reason ON r_reason_sk = wr_reason_sk
WHERE (
    (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND cd2.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
    OR
    (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
    OR
    (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
)
AND (
    (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IN', 'VA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
    OR
    (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('MT', 'NM', 'OR') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
    OR
    (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'OH') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
);

tpch.rewritten_query:
WITH store_sales_sub AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203
    JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947
    WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27
),
catalog_sales_sub AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203
    JOIN customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947
    WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27
),
web_sales_sub AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203
    JOIN customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947
    WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    (SELECT * FROM store_sales_sub)
    EXCEPT
    (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales_sub)
    EXCEPT
    (SELECT * FROM web_sales_sub)
) cool_cust;

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT 
    cc_call_center_id Call_Center, 
    cc_name Call_Center_Name, 
    cc_manager Manager, 
    SUM(cr_net_loss) Returns_Loss 
FROM 
    call_center 
    JOIN ( 
        SELECT * 
        FROM catalog_returns 
        WHERE cr_returned_date_sk IN ( 
            SELECT d_date_sk 
            FROM date_dim 
            WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 5 
        ) 
    ) AS catalog_returns ON cr_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk 
    JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
        AND date_dim.d_year = 1999 AND date_dim.d_moy = 5 
    JOIN customer ON cr_returning_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
    JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk 
        AND ca_gmt_offset = -7 
    JOIN customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk
